app.name: ATLAS CashOps
app.tagline: 전 세계 소상공인을 위한 AI 경영 운영체제

demo.banner: 데모 데이터는 {date} 기준입니다. 새 입력은 실제 현재 시각을 사용합니다.

mode.demoBody: Explore with realistic sample data. Nothing is sent and no real systems are touched.
mode.productionBody: Connect your accounting, payments and commerce sources. ATLAS reads them to forecast cash and draft actions — it never sends or pays on its own.

onboarding.title: ATLAS에 오신 것을 환영합니다
onboarding.subtitle: 1분 안에 설정하세요. ATLAS가 오늘부터 당신을 위해 일합니다.
onboarding.stepIndustry: What kind of business do you run?
onboarding.stepDataSource: Where does your money data live?
onboarding.dataSourceHint: Pick one or more. You can add the rest later.
onboarding.cashSafetyLineHint: ATLAS warns you before cash dips below this.

dashboard.title: 오늘
dashboard.headlineSafe: Your cash holds above the safety line for the next 13 weeks. Lowest point is {lowest}.
dashboard.headlineWatch: Cash gets tight in the weeks ahead. Lowest projected cash is {lowest}, near your safety line of {safety}.
dashboard.headlineRisk: Cash is projected to fall below your safety line of {safety}, bottoming at {lowest}. Act on the top actions now.
dashboard.noActions: No actions need your attention right now.
dashboard.runwayMeaning: How long your cash lasts at the current trajectory.
dashboard.dsoMeaning: Average days to collect an invoice. Lower is healthier.

forecast.title: 13-week cash forecast
forecast.subtitle: Deterministic projection from your bank, AR, AP, payroll and recurring costs.
forecast.noBreach: No breach in the next 13 weeks
forecast.clickHint: Click any week to see the line items behind it.

collections.title: Receivables & collections
collections.subtitle: See who owes you, who to chase first, and draft the message — you stay in control.

draft.title: Collect {amount} from {name}
draft.rationale: Invoice is {days} days overdue; recovering it frees up {amount} of working cash.

body.friendly: Hi {name}, just a friendly reminder that invoice {invoice} for {amount} is now {days} days past due. Could you let us know when payment will arrive? Thank you!
body.firm: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice} for {amount} is {days} days overdue. Please arrange payment within 3 business days or reply with a payment date so we can update our records.
body.final_notice: Hi {name}, this is a final notice for invoice {invoice} of {amount}, now {days} days overdue. Please settle within 48 hours to avoid further collection steps. Contact us immediately if there is an issue.

collections.toastDrafted: Collection draft added to Action Center

payables.title: Payables & vendor negotiation
payables.subtitle: Classify what must be paid, what can wait, and draft negotiation requests.

reason.largeFlexible: Large flexible bill of {amount} — negotiate installments

draft.rationale: Deferring {amount} by {days} days smooths a tight cash week.

body.delay: Hi {name}, we value our partnership. Could we extend bill {bill} for {amount} by {days} days? We'll confirm the new date in writing and keep everything else on schedule.
body.installment: Hi {name}, regarding bill {bill} for {amount}: could we split this into installments over the next {days} days? We want to keep paying you reliably while managing a short cash crunch.

payables.toastDrafted: Negotiation draft added to Action Center

advisor.title: AI Advisor
advisor.subtitle: Ask about cash, collections or payables. Every answer is grounded in your data.
advisor.placeholder: e.g. What's my cash runway? Who should I chase first?
advisor.structureNote: Every answer follows a fixed structure: direct answer, evidence, risk, recommended action, and draft actions — grounded only in your connected data.

sample.collections: Who should I chase for payment first?
sample.draft: Draft a payment reminder for my biggest overdue invoice
sample.metrics: What's my DSO and cash at risk?

action.executeConfirmBody: ATLAS가 이 액션을 기록하고 감사 로그를 남깁니다. 이 데모에서는 실제로 발송되지 않습니다.

actions.title: 액션 센터
actions.subtitle: ATLAS가 초안을 만들고, 당신이 승인하며 주도권을 유지합니다.
actions.empty: 대기 중인 액션이 없습니다. 모두 처리되었습니다.
actions.draftFirst: ATLAS가 먼저 초안을 준비합니다. 승인 전에는 아무것도 발송되지 않습니다.
actions.humanInLoop: Human-in-the-loop: every message, payment and change needs your confirmation.
actions.toastMetered: You've hit your monthly action limit. Upgrade for unlimited actions.

audit.title: Audit & trust
audit.subtitle: Every action is logged. Your data, your control.
audit.deleteConfirm: This permanently clears this business's data in the demo. Continue?
audit.privacyBody: Sensitive financial detail is redacted for roles without permission. Production connectors use read-only access scopes.
audit.redactionNote: Amounts are redacted for your role.

dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.subtitle: Connect accounting, payments and commerce. ATLAS reads them — read-only.
dataSources.mockNote: All connectors are mock adapters in this build. Each implements the same typed interface, so real APIs can be plugged in without changing the app.
dataSources.premiumLocked: Available on Pro and Managed plans.

csv.name: CSV upload
csv.desc: Import bank, AR and AP from spreadsheets.

manual.name: Manual entry
manual.desc: Enter balances and bills by hand.

pricing.title: 요금제
pricing.subtitle: Start free for 14 days. Upgrade as your cash gets more complex.
pricing.lockedBody: This feature is available on the {plan} plan.

starter.name: Starter
starter.tagline: For a single owner getting cash under control.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: For growing teams that need real integrations.

managed.name: Managed
managed.tagline: For owners who want an accountant-led workflow.

settings.title: 설정
settings.subtitle: 언어, 형식, 개인정보, 컴플라이언스.
settings.roleSimulatorHint: 다른 역할로 ATLAS를 미리 봅니다. 보이는 내용과 가능한 작업이 바뀝니다.
settings.languageIndependentNote: 인터페이스 언어와 AI 어드바이저 언어는 독립적입니다. 예: 한국어로 보면서 ATLAS는 영어로 리포트 작성.

compliance.disclaimer: ATLAS는 경영 보조 정보를 제공하며 공인회계사, 변호사, 세무사 또는 등록 재무 자문을 대체하지 않습니다.

answer.forecastSafe: You're covered. Lowest projected cash is {lowest}, above your safety line of {safety}.
answer.forecastRisk: Cash gets tight. Projected cash dips to {lowest}, below your safety line of {safety}.
answer.collections: You have {amount} overdue. I've prioritized {count} customers worth chasing first.
answer.payables: You have {amount} in bills due within 14 days; {count} could be delayed or negotiated.
answer.metrics: You have about {runway} days of runway and a DSO of {dso} days.
answer.draftReady: I drafted a collection message for {name} to recover about {amount}.
answer.compliance: 일반 안내입니다 — 구체적인 사항은 자격 있는 전문가에게 확인하세요.
answer.noOverdue: Nothing is overdue right now, so there's no collection message to draft.
answer.noBank: I can't see a bank balance yet. Connect a bank or accounting source.
answer.noForecast: I can't build a forecast yet. Connect a data source to get started.
answer.noAr: I can't see receivables yet. Connect an accounting or payments source.
answer.noAp: I can't see payables yet. Connect an accounting source.
answer.noMetrics: I need connected data before I can compute your metrics.
answer.unknown: 아직 잘 모르겠습니다. 매출, 현금흐름, 고객, 직원에 대해 물어보세요.

ev.operationalOnly: ATLAS gives operational guidance, not formal tax/legal/lending advice.
ev.tryAsking: Try: cash runway, who to chase, or which bills to delay.

risk.breach: Cash is projected to fall below your safety line within 13 weeks.
risk.staleAr: {amount} of receivables are over 90 days old and may be hard to recover.

next.collectFirst: Chase the largest overdue invoice first — it frees the most cash.
next.collectTop: Start with {name}, your highest-priority overdue account.
next.reviewDraft: Review the draft, then approve to add it to the Action Center.
next.consultPro: Confirm tax, legal or lending specifics with a licensed professional.

connect.bank: Connect a bank or accounting source
connect.ar: Connect an accounting or payments source
connect.forecast: Connect bank + AR + AP to forecast

tool.getForecast: Run the 13-week cash forecast for a scenario.
tool.getCollectionTargets: Rank overdue invoices to chase first.
tool.getPayablesPlan: Classify bills as must-pay, can-delay or can-negotiate.
tool.getMetrics: Read dashboard metrics (runway, DSO, cash at risk).
tool.draftCollectionMessage: Draft a collection message for review.
tool.draftVendorNegotiation: Draft a vendor payment-term request for review.

validation.selectOne: Please select at least one option
